svg.title: HuntWick identity review, four unselected concepts
svg.text: Compare the H, the lens and the wordmark at desktop and small-icon sizes.

g.text: The right upright ends in a raised, angled loupe.
The lens occupies the crossbar and joins the right stroke.
An enlarged lens and diagonal neck lead into the i stem.
The glass and its handle are cut into a solid teal shape.
